title: Thought Leader — Episode 6: The Movement
about: A lawful campaign for a fictional human candidate openly delegates daily coordination to CHORUS, an AI system, while members provide labor, policy, votes, dissent, and revocable authority. Agents Voidt and Lamport test whether distributed authorship can constitute legitimate collective agency without hiding human responsibility. Eight exclusive findings span Mandate and Assembly plus three work-based resolutions.
